WITH q AS (
  SELECT lower(btrim($1::text)) AS n, lower(btrim($2::text)) AS c, btrim($3::text) AS ph, lower(btrim($4::text)) AS em
)
SELECT l.id, l.name, l.company, l.stage,
  to_char(l.follow_up_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS follow_up,
  (CASE
    WHEN q.ph <> '' AND l.phone = q.ph THEN 1.0
    WHEN q.em <> '' AND lower(l.email) = q.em THEN 1.0
    WHEN q.n = '' THEN 0.0
    WHEN q.c = '' THEN GREATEST(similarity(lower(l.name), q.n), word_similarity(q.n, lower(l.name)))
    ELSE 0.6 * GREATEST(similarity(lower(l.name), q.n), word_similarity(q.n, lower(l.name)))
       + 0.4 * GREATEST(similarity(lower(COALESCE(l.company, '')), q.c), word_similarity(q.c, lower(COALESCE(l.company, ''))))
  END)::float8 AS match_score
FROM leads l, q
ORDER BY match_score DESC, l.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d, $2::int AS lid),
up AS (
  UPDATE leads l SET
    company        = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'company'), ''), l.company),
    phone          = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'phone'), ''), l.phone),
    email          = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'email'), ''), l.email),
    need           = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'need'), ''), l.need),
    budget_signal  = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'budget_signal'), ''), l.budget_signal),
    urgency        = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.d->>'urgency', ''), l.urgency),
    stage          = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.d->>'stage_update', ''), l.stage),
    follow_up_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.d->>'follow_up_date', '')::date, l.follow_up_date),
    lead_score     = compute_lead_score(
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(p.d->>'urgency', ''), l.urgency),
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'budget_signal'), ''), l.budget_signal),
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(p.d->>'stage_update', ''), l.stage),
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'phone'), ''), l.phone),
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.d->>'email'), ''), l.email)),
    last_contact_at = now(),
    updated_at      = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE l.id = p.lid
  RETURNING l.id, l.name, l.stage, l.lead_score, to_char(l.follow_up_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS follow_up
),
ix AS (
  INSERT INTO interactions (lead_id, source_type, raw_transcript, summary, extracted)
  SELECT up.id, p.d->>'source_type', p.d->>'raw_text', p.d->>'notes', p.d
  FROM up, p
)
SELECT id, name, stage, lead_score, follow_up, 'updated' AS action FROM up;

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
nl AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (name, company, phone, email, need, budget_signal, urgency, stage, follow_up_date, lead_score)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(d->>'name'), ''), 'Unknown'),
    NULLIF(btrim(d->>'company'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(d->>'phone'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(d->>'email'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(d->>'need'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(d->>'budget_signal'), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'urgency', ''), 'medium'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'stage_update', ''), 'new'),
    NULLIF(d->>'follow_up_date', '')::date,
    compute_lead_score(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'urgency', ''), 'medium'),
      d->>'budget_signal',
      COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'stage_update', ''), 'new'),
      d->>'phone',
      d->>'email')
  FROM p
  RETURNING id, name, stage, lead_score, to_char(follow_up_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS follow_up
),
ix AS (
  INSERT INTO interactions (lead_id, source_type, raw_transcript, summary, extracted)
  SELECT nl.id, p.d->>'source_type', p.d->>'raw_text', p.d->>'notes', p.d
  FROM nl, p
)
SELECT id, name, stage, lead_score, follow_up, 'created' AS action FROM nl;

parameters.text: ⚠️ I could not find that lead any more (it may have been deleted). Nothing was saved. Send the note again and choose Save as new.

👋 Voice Lead Manager Send me: • a voice note after a call or meeting (Hindi, English or Hinglish) • a photo of a business card (add a caption if you like) • or just type the note I'll extract the lead, check for duplicates and ask you to confirm before saving anything. Say things like "Rahul agreed, move him to proposal" to update an existing lead. /today shows follow-ups due and leads going cold. A digest also arrives every morning at 8:30.
I can handle voice notes, text, and business-card photos (up to 3 MB). Send /help for details.

parameters.query:
WITH t AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE $1::text)::date AS d)
SELECT l.id, l.name, l.company, l.stage, l.lead_score,
  to_char(l.follow_up_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS follow_up,
  (t.d - l.follow_up_date) AS days_overdue,
  GREATEST(0, floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - l.last_contact_at)) / 86400))::int AS days_since_contact,
  (CASE WHEN l.follow_up_date = t.d THEN 'today'
        WHEN l.follow_up_date < t.d THEN 'overdue'
        ELSE 'cold' END) AS bucket,
  (SELECT i.summary FROM interactions i WHERE i.lead_id = l.id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_note
FROM leads l, t
WHERE l.stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost')
  AND (l.follow_up_date <= t.d
       OR (l.follow_up_date IS NULL AND l.last_contact_at < now() - make_interval(days => $2::int)))
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN l.follow_up_date = t.d THEN 1 WHEN l.follow_up_date < t.d THEN 2 ELSE 3 END),
         l.lead_score DESC
LIMIT 25;
DELETE FROM pending_notes WHERE created_at < now() - interval '2 days';

parameters.content:
## Voice Lead Manager (Telegram)
**Who is this for?**
Sales people and freelancers who capture leads on the go, in English, Hindi or Hinglish.

**What does it do?**
- Takes a voice note, a business-card photo or plain text on Telegram
- Turns it into a structured lead using Groq (Whisper, Vision, LLM)
- Checks Postgres for a likely duplicate, then asks you to confirm
- Saves or updates the lead only after you tap a button
- Sends a daily 8:30 digest of follow-ups and cold leads

**Setup requirements**
- Telegram bot token (BotFather)
- Postgres database (run `schema.sql`)
- Groq API key (Header Auth)

**Quick start**
Follow the Setup note below, activate the workflow, message the bot.

## 1. Receive & Authorize
Both triggers share one entry path.

**How it works**
- *Telegram Trigger* fires on every message or button tap
- *Daily 8:30 Digest* fires the morning summary and cleans expired pending items
- **Config** holds allowed chat IDs, timezone and model names
- **Normalize Update** converts any update into one clean shape (voice, photo, text, callback)
- *Fraud ?* blocks unknown chats with an Unauthorized reply

## 2. Input to Text
Every input type ends up as plain text.

**How it works**
- *Route by Kind* sends voice, photo, text, button taps, help, digest and unsupported to their branches
- **Voice:** download file, fix filename, transcribe with Groq Whisper
- **Photo:** download, build vision request, Groq Vision reads the card
- **Text:** used as is
- API failures go to the error reply

## 3. AI Extraction
Text becomes a structured lead.

**How it works**
- *Has Text?* replies "Nothing Heard" if the input is empty
- **Build Extraction Request** prompts the Groq LLM for JSON (name, company, phone, follow-up date, notes)
- **Parse & Validate** checks the JSON and marks low-confidence fields
- *Parse OK?* sends bad output to a Parse Failed reply

## 4. Match & Confirm
Nothing is saved yet.

**How it works**
- **Find Matches** looks up similar leads in Postgres
- **Build Confirmation** keeps up to 3 candidates with score 0.6 or more
- **Save Pending** stores the proposed lead until you tap a button
- **Prepare Keyboard** builds the buttons
- *Candidate Count* picks the message for 0, 1, 2 or 3 matches

## 5. Send Confirmation
**How it works**
- One Send node per match count
- Shows the extracted lead, with a warning mark on low-confidence fields
- Buttons: update an existing lead, create new, or cancel

## 6. Button Handling
**How it works**
- **Answer Callback** stops the loading spinner in Telegram
- **Parse Callback** and *Valid Callback?* reject bad buttons
- **Claim Pending** takes the saved proposal once, so double taps do nothing
- *Pending Found?* replies Expired if it is gone
- *Action* routes to update, new or cancel

## 7. Save Lead
**How it works**
- **Update Lead** or **Create Lead** writes to Postgres
- *Saved?* checks the result
- **Format Saved Reply** and **Send Saved** confirm to you
- Failures send a Save Failed reply

## 8. Daily Digest
**How it works**
- Runs at 8:30 every morning (timezone set in Config); stays silent if nothing is due
- **Digest Query** pulls follow-ups due today, overdue ones and leads gone cold (max 25)
- **Build Digest** formats the message
- **Send Digest** posts it to Telegram
- Sending /today in chat runs it on demand

## 10. Error Handling


**How it works**
The silent failures are caught and users are notified
